title: Mental Workload Classification and Tasks Detection in Multitasking: Deep Learning Insights from EEG Study
summary: Deep-learning EEG pipeline classifies task and workload levels; Methods documents EEG acquisition and model evaluation. Results reports task detection but limited discrimination of high workload levels, a bounded empirical finding.
